# Generating an LCM image and performing Inpainting

```shell Shell
curl --request POST \
     --url https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations-lcm \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --data '
{
  "width": 1024,
  "height": 1024,
  "imageDataUrl": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "prompt": "bouquet of bright purple roses",
  "style": "FANTASY_ART"
}
'
# Note the imageDataUrl in the response

curl --request POST \
     --url https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/lcm-inpainting \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --data '
{
  "width": 1024,
  "height": 1024,
  "maskDataUrl": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "imageDataUrl": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "prompt": "a red rose",
  "guidance": 5
}
'

```

```json Response Example
{
  "lcmGenerationJob": {
    "imageDataUrl": [
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
    ],
    "requestTimestamp": null,
    "apiCreditCost": 4
  }
}
```

# Generate with base64 image

<!-- shell@1-15 -->

This command creates an LCM generation with an example body.

To use this command, first replace <YOUR_API_KEY> with your API key. Then, run it in your terminal.

Note the imageDataUrl needs to be a base64 Image String and in .jpeg format only.

Style refers to the artistic style that the image will be generated with. A dropdown of styles are available in the API reference. 

Keep note of the imageDataUrl in the response for the next step.

# Performing Inpainting using a mask image

<!-- shell@17-31 -->

To perform Inpainting, replace the imageDataUrl with the imageDataUrl that returned in the previous call. Add in your Inpaint image into maskDataUrl. Add your prompt for the masked image.

Note the maskDataUrl needs to be a base64 Image String and in .jpeg format only. 

Make sure to keep the maskDataUrl dimensions the same as the imageDataUrl. Colour can be used in the mask or leave it white on a black background.

The response will contain another imageDataUrl with a base64 image that will have the prompt applied to the mask on your LCM image.
